claims.claim: 挪威 TDM 登记库以 147,964 次抗精神病药测量构建各药人群 C/D 分布，作为剂量校正浓度（C/D）的外部人群基准。
claims.sourceTitle: Rapid Metabolism Underlying Subtherapeutic Serum Levels of Atypical Antipsychotics Preceding Clozapine Treatment: A Retrospective Analysis of Real-World Data
claims.supportQuote: interquartile ranges of population-based CDs were prepared for the relevant antipsychotic drugs from the measurements in the TDM registry at the study site ( n = 147,964, Table S1 in the electronic supplementary material [ESM])
claims.applicability: 外部基准对照方向的方法学基础；适用于本研究及其它单中心 TDM 数据
claims.uncertainty: 数值 147,964 出自该引文原句（the measurements in the TDM registry at the study site ( n = 147,964 ...)），以千位分隔符书写；若按千位分隔拆分，147 与 964 两个整数均可在该引文中定位。

claims.claim: 低/正常剂量校正浓度（LCD/NCD）按该药人群 C/D 的第 25/75 分位点界定。
claims.sourceTitle: Rapid Metabolism Underlying Subtherapeutic Serum Levels of Atypical Antipsychotics Preceding Clozapine Treatment: A Retrospective Analysis of Real-World Data
claims.supportQuote: Those with at least one measurement with CD of non-clozapine antipsychotics below the 25th percentile of the respective drug’s population-based CDs were assigned to the LCD (cases) group, whereas patients who exhibited CDs between the 25th and 75th percentiles were assigned to the normal CD group (NCD, controls).
claims.applicability: 可用于本院 C/D 档位划分的小样本复制
claims.uncertainty: 百分位基准来自挪威人群，本院样本不足以自建百分位

claims.claim: AGNP 共识推荐的亚治疗浓度下限：阿立哌唑活性部分 150 µg/L、奥氮平 20 µg/L（另：喹硫平 100、利培酮活性部分 20 µg/L）。
claims.sourceTitle: Rapid Metabolism Underlying Subtherapeutic Serum Levels of Atypical Antipsychotics Preceding Clozapine Treatment: A Retrospective Analysis of Real-World Data
claims.supportQuote: These were aripiprazole active moiety 335 nmol/L (150 µg/L, aripiprazole plus dehydroaripiprazole), olanzapine 64 nmol/L (20 µg/L), quetiapine 261 nmol/L (100 µg/L), risperidone active moiety 47 nmol/L (20 µg/L, risperidone plus 9-hydroxyrisperidone).
claims.applicability: 本院总阿立哌唑/奥氮平低于下限档位的判定标准
claims.uncertainty: 原文以 nmol/L 为准，µg/L 为作者换算值；本院浓度单位需换算一致

claims.claim: 挪威队列 272 例中 40.4%（110 例）在起始氯氮平前呈低剂量校正浓度状态。
claims.sourceTitle: Rapid Metabolism Underlying Subtherapeutic Serum Levels of Atypical Antipsychotics Preceding Clozapine Treatment: A Retrospective Analysis of Real-World Data
claims.supportQuote: In total, 272 patients who had a TDM history of non-clozapine, atypical antipsychotics (aripiprazole, risperidone, olanzapine, or quetiapine) preceding clozapine treatment were included in the study. Among the included patients, 110 (40.4%) were identified with LCD at the last TDM event within 1 year before clozapine treatment.
claims.applicability: 提示低 C/D 在真实世界常见，可作为本院对照的文献锚点
claims.uncertainty: 高加索人群、氯氮平前队列，非一般住院人群

claims.claim: 剂量归一化浓度（C/D）=母药浓度÷日剂量；代谢物比值=代谢物浓度÷母药浓度。
claims.sourceTitle: Rapid Metabolism Underlying Subtherapeutic Serum Levels of Atypical Antipsychotics Preceding Clozapine Treatment: A Retrospective Analysis of Real-World Data
claims.supportQuote: Metabolic ratio was estimated by the ratio of the metabolite (nmol/L) and parent drug concentration (nmol/L). CD was calculated as a ratio of parent drug concentration (nmol/L) and total daily dose (mg/day).
claims.applicability: 本院所有 C/D 与比值计算的统一定义
claims.uncertainty: 本院无采血时刻，C/D 的稳态/谷浓度语义无法保证

claims.claim: 挪威队列中低 C/D 组阿立哌唑亚治疗浓度比例 30.0%，正常组 5.7%（p=0.021）。
claims.sourceTitle: Rapid Metabolism Underlying Subtherapeutic Serum Levels of Atypical Antipsychotics Preceding Clozapine Treatment: A Retrospective Analysis of Real-World Data
claims.supportQuote: we observed higher proportions of subtherapeutic absolute serum concentrations among LCD patients treated with aripiprazole (30.0% vs 5.7%; p = 0.021), olanzapine (23.1% vs 7.1; p = 0.044), and quetiapine (63.6% vs 36.1%; p = 0.005) compared with the NCD patients
claims.applicability: 本院低于下限比例的文献对照值
claims.uncertainty: 比例依赖其人群与送检习惯，仅作方向性对照

claims.claim: 脱氢阿立哌唑约为阿立哌唑稳态浓度的 40%，稳态约 14 天达峰；阿立哌唑半衰期 58 至 78 h，CYP2D6 慢代谢者可达 140 h。
claims.sourceTitle: Genetic Polymorphisms Associated With the Pharmacokinetics, Pharmacodynamics and Adverse Effects of Olanzapine, Aripiprazole and Risperidone
claims.supportQuote: Its main and only active metabolite is dehydro-aripiprazole, which amounts to 40% of aripiprazole concentration at steady state, reached after 14 days of treatment ( Kinghorn and McEvoy, 2005 ). The T 1/2 varies between 58 and 78 h and can reach 140 h in CYP2D6 poor metabolizers (PMs)
claims.applicability: 代谢物比值作为 CYP2D6 活性内源探针的文献依据
claims.uncertainty: 40% 为综述转引的正常代谢者人群均值，个体变异大

claims.claim: DPWG 与 FDA 建议 CYP2D6 慢代谢者减量阿立哌唑；合并 CYP3A4 强抑制剂建议减至 1/4 剂量。
claims.sourceTitle: Genetic Polymorphisms Associated With the Pharmacokinetics, Pharmacodynamics and Adverse Effects of Olanzapine, Aripiprazole and Risperidone
claims.supportQuote: Regarding aripiprazole, a reduced dose should be administered in CYP2D6 poor metabolizers (PMs). Additionally, a reduction to a quarter of the normal dose is recommended if the patient is treated with concomitant CYP3A4 inhibitors.
claims.applicability: 无基因型时只能作背景知识；不能据此为患者做剂量建议
claims.uncertainty: 指南原文以 a quarter of the normal dose 表述 1/4 剂量（1/4 为对原文措辞的转写）；该指南针对基因型已知人群，本院无基因型字段。

claims.claim: CPIC 于 2009 年由 PGRN 与 PharmGKB 联合建立，与 DPWG 共同提供代谢表型-剂量注释体系。
claims.sourceTitle: Genetic Polymorphisms Associated With the Pharmacokinetics, Pharmacodynamics and Adverse Effects of Olanzapine, Aripiprazole and Risperidone
claims.supportQuote: two of the most important groups that develop pharmacogenetic guidelines are the Clinical Pharmacogenetics Implementation Consortium (CPIC) ( Caudle et al., 2014 ) and the Dutch Pharmacogenetics Working Group (DPWG) ( Bank et al., 2018 ). The CPIC was established in 2009 as a joint project between the Pharmacogenomics Research Network (PGRN) and the Pharmacogenomics Knowledge Base (PharmGKB)
claims.applicability: 药物基因组学资源定位；PharmGKB/CPIC/DPWG 是外部表型知识来源
claims.uncertainty: 本报告未直接访问 PharmGKB/CPIC/DPWG 原站（连接器不可用），仅据综述记载

claims.claim: 奥氮平浓度受吸烟（CYP1A2 诱导）影响而降低。
claims.sourceTitle: Genetic Polymorphisms Associated With the Pharmacokinetics, Pharmacodynamics and Adverse Effects of Olanzapine, Aripiprazole and Risperidone
claims.supportQuote: Tobacco induces CYP1A2 activity, what leads to reduced olanzapine plasma concentration. Thus, smoking affects olanzapine Cl, however, dosage modifications are not routinely recommended
claims.applicability: 奥氮平浓度解释必须考虑吸烟；本院无吸烟字段故解释受限
claims.uncertainty: 吸烟-剂量关系为综述级证据

claims.claim: 阿立哌唑最常见不良反应（>10%）以锥体外系效应、头痛、激越、静坐不能、恶心呕吐等为主。
claims.sourceTitle: Genetic Polymorphisms Associated With the Pharmacokinetics, Pharmacodynamics and Adverse Effects of Olanzapine, Aripiprazole and Risperidone
claims.supportQuote: The most common adverse drug reactions (>10% patients) to aripiprazole are mostly extrapyramidal effects, headache, agitation, insomnia, anxiety, nausea and vomiting, akathisia, light-headedness, and constipation ( Prommer, 2017 ).
claims.applicability: 说明书/文献预期 ADR 与本院诊断（肌张力障碍、迟发性运动障碍）对照
claims.uncertainty: 以说明书/上市后数据为基础，个体风险因人而异

claims.claim: AGNP 报告的阿立哌唑治疗参考范围（谷浓度）为 100 至 350 ng/mL，活性部分（母药+脱氢）为 150 至 500 ng/mL。
claims.sourceTitle: Towards Precision Medicine in Clinical Practice: Alinity C vs. UHPLC-MS/MS in Plasma Aripiprazole Determination
claims.supportQuote: The therapeutic reference range trough values were reported by the the TDM task force of the Arbeitsgemeinschaft für Neuropsychopharmakologie und Pharmakopsychiatrie (AGNP) between 100 and 350 ng/mL for aripiprazole and 150 and 500 ng/mL for the active moiety (aripiprazole plus dehydroaripiprazole) [ 4 ].
claims.applicability: 本院参考范围的溯源核对与四档分类标尺
claims.uncertainty: 经 Toja-Camba 转引 AGNP，非 AGNP 原文

claims.claim: Hart 2022 荟萃分析提出修订范围：阿立哌唑 120–270、活性部分 180–380 ng/mL。
claims.sourceTitle: Towards Precision Medicine in Clinical Practice: Alinity C vs. UHPLC-MS/MS in Plasma Aripiprazole Determination
claims.supportQuote: Recently, new reference ranges were proposed of 120–270 ng/mL and 180–380 ng/mL, respectively, for aripiprazole and its active moiety by Hart et al. [ 5 ].
claims.applicability: 支持双标尺并列报告以应对参考范围版本冲突
claims.uncertainty: 修订范围仍在同行讨论中，未取代 AGNP 2017

claims.claim: 免疫法（Alinity C）与 UHPLC-MS/MS 相比，在 15% 的病例会得出不同的临床决策。
claims.sourceTitle: Towards Precision Medicine in Clinical Practice: Alinity C vs. UHPLC-MS/MS in Plasma Aripiprazole Determination
claims.supportQuote: Nonetheless, clinical decisions could be different in 15% of the cases depending on the chosen method.
claims.applicability: 外部基准对照前必须先确认本院测定方法并声明偏倚
claims.uncertainty: 该 15% 来自 86 例样本的西班牙研究，泛化性有限

claims.claim: 免疫法对阿立哌唑活性部分的测定系统偏高（Passing–Bablok 斜率 1.12）。
claims.sourceTitle: Towards Precision Medicine in Clinical Practice: Alinity C vs. UHPLC-MS/MS in Plasma Aripiprazole Determination
claims.supportQuote: Passing–Bablock regression showed a good correlation among methods (rs = 0.93) and a slope of 1.12 indicating a slight tendency of Alinity C to measure higher values than UHPLC-MS/MS.
claims.applicability: 若本院为免疫法则 C/D 定量对照需修正或降级
claims.uncertainty: 斜率来自单一试剂盒（Saladax/Alinity C）

claims.claim: 免疫法只报告活性部分，不区分母药与脱氢代谢物。
claims.sourceTitle: Towards Precision Medicine in Clinical Practice: Alinity C vs. UHPLC-MS/MS in Plasma Aripiprazole Determination
claims.supportQuote: Since the Alinity C system does not provide concentrations of aripiprazole and dehydroaripipiprazole singularly, but only reports the active moiety
claims.applicability: 决定代谢物比值分析是否可行（要求色谱法拆分）
claims.uncertainty: 仅针对该试剂盒的说明

claims.claim: 中国各机构精神药物监测浓度范围不一致（如奥氮平、氯氮平因机构或方法而异）。
claims.sourceTitle: A Survey of Therapeutic Drug Monitoring Status in China
claims.supportQuote: The monitored concentration ranges for some of the drugs, such as voriconazole, olanzapine, clozapine, cyclosporine, and others, may vary depending on the medical institution or the type of testing method used.
claims.applicability: 本院参考范围与外院/文献对照的跨机构差异背景
claims.uncertainty: 调查为自报问卷，2019 年数据

claims.claim: 中国 TDM 常用项目以万古霉素、丙戊酸、甲氨蝶呤、卡马西平、环孢素、伏立康唑为主。
claims.sourceTitle: A Survey of Therapeutic Drug Monitoring Status in China
claims.supportQuote: vancomycin, valproic acid, methotrexate, carbamazepine, cyclosporine, and voriconazole were the most common projects for which TDM had been performed
claims.applicability: 抗精神病药 TDM 在中国 TDM 版图中的定位（非主流）
claims.uncertainty: 调查对象偏倚（25 省 475 份问卷）

claims.claim: 中国药理学会治疗药物监测研究专业委员会已发布《治疗药物监测结果解读专家共识》。
claims.sourceTitle: A Survey of Therapeutic Drug Monitoring Status in China
claims.supportQuote: Division of TDM, Chinese Pharmacological Society published expert consensus on “The Interpretation of Therapeutic Drug Monitoring Results.”
claims.applicability: 中文解读框架存在性的依据
claims.uncertainty: 经 Yin 2023 转引；原文未取得

claims.claim: 国家临床检验中心已启动覆盖 33 种药物的精神药物/抗抑郁药外部质量评估（EQA）计划。
claims.sourceTitle: A Survey of Therapeutic Drug Monitoring Status in China
claims.supportQuote: which launched the national “EQA Investigation Plan for antibiotic drugs, antifungal drugs, antitumor drugs, psychotropic drugs and antidepressants” 28 covering 33 drugs
claims.applicability: 跨机构浓度可比性的质量基础设施证据
claims.uncertainty: EQA 为能力验证性质，不解决参考范围统一问题

claims.claim: 挪威 Diakonhjemmet TDM 数据库支持十年跨度人群浓度-剂量比较（17,811 例患者、24,358 次测量）。
claims.sourceTitle: Use of Antidepressants in Older People during a 10-Year Period: An Observational Study on Prescribed Doses and Serum Levels
claims.supportQuote: Overall, 17,811 patients, regardless of age, with a total of 24,358 TDM analyses, were extracted from the TDM database (Fig. 1 ).
claims.applicability: 超范围比例作为小样本可复制结局的方法学模板
claims.uncertainty: 数值 17,811 与 24,358 均出自该引文原句（17,811 patients ... 24,358 TDM analyses），以千位分隔符书写。

claims.claim: TDM 数据库以“血清浓度高于参考范围上限”作为结局判定（2017 年老年组 10.6% vs 年轻组 6.0%）。
claims.sourceTitle: Use of Antidepressants in Older People during a 10-Year Period: An Observational Study on Prescribed Doses and Serum Levels
claims.supportQuote: In both 2007 and 2017, the proportion of individuals with at least one serum concentration above the recommended reference range was almost doubled among older individuals compared with younger individuals (16.8% vs. 9.0% in 2007 and 10.6% vs. 6.0% in 2017)
claims.applicability: 本院超上限比例结局定义与文献值
claims.uncertainty: 人群为挪威老年抗抑郁药使用者

claims.claim: 浓度高于参考范围上限不等于过量用药；参考范围不是绝对治疗范围。
claims.sourceTitle: Use of Antidepressants in Older People during a 10-Year Period: An Observational Study on Prescribed Doses and Serum Levels
claims.supportQuote: It must be noted that serum concentrations above the recommended reference range does not necessarily mean overmedication, as the TDM reference ranges are not absolutely defined therapeutic ranges.
claims.applicability: 所有档位表述的措辞边界（写相对位置而非异常）

claims.claim: AGNP 共识（历次更新版本）为 154 种精神神经药物提供治疗参考范围。
claims.sourceTitle: Therapeutic Drug Monitoring of Second- and Third-Generation Antipsychotic Drugs—Influence of Smoking Behavior and Inflammation on Pharmacokinetics
claims.supportQuote: their guidelines address theoretical as well as practical aspects of TDM and provide therapeutic reference ranges for 154 neuropsychiatric drugs
claims.applicability: AGNP 体系权威性与覆盖范围的证据
claims.uncertainty: 经 Moschny 综述转引

claims.claim: 参考范围针对活性部分（母药+药理学活性代谢物之和），而非单个化合物。
claims.sourceTitle: Therapeutic Drug Monitoring of Second- and Third-Generation Antipsychotic Drugs—Influence of Smoking Behavior and Inflammation on Pharmacokinetics
claims.supportQuote: These therapeutic reference ranges refer not only to the initially applied chemical substance, but to the active moiety, i.e., the sum of parent compound and its pharmacodynamically active metabolites
claims.applicability: 解释总阿立哌唑必须与活性部分口径一致

claims.claim: 吸烟经 CYP1A2 诱导使氯氮平平均浓度降低 20–40%；戒烟建议剂量下调 30–50%。
claims.sourceTitle: Therapeutic Drug Monitoring of Second- and Third-Generation Antipsychotic Drugs—Influence of Smoking Behavior and Inflammation on Pharmacokinetics
claims.supportQuote: Published reports document 20–40% lower mean serum clozapine concentrations in smokers (up to 14 cigarettes per day) compared with nonsmokers due to enzyme induction [ 67 ]. When a patient stops smoking, dose reduction of clozapine of 30–50% is recommended [ 213 , 215 ].
claims.applicability: 本院氯氮平浓度解释的最大未知混杂（无吸烟字段）
claims.uncertainty: 综述级证据；个体戒烟效应变异大

claims.claim: 阿立哌唑（及布瑞哌唑、卡利拉嗪、鲁拉西酮、喹硫平、舍吲哚）的血药浓度不受吸烟影响。
claims.sourceTitle: Therapeutic Drug Monitoring of Second- and Third-Generation Antipsychotic Drugs—Influence of Smoking Behavior and Inflammation on Pharmacokinetics
claims.supportQuote: The plasma levels of other SGAs and TGAs, such as aripiprazole [ 226 ], brexpiprazole [ 227 ], cariprazine [ 228 ], lurasidone [ 229 ], quetiapine [ 230 ], and sertindole [ 231 ], are not affected by cigarette smoking.
claims.applicability: 阿立哌唑相关对照无需吸烟校正

claims.claim: 氯氮平参考范围为 350–600 ng/mL（文献标准表述）。
claims.sourceTitle: Therapeutic Drug Monitoring of Second- and Third-Generation Antipsychotic Drugs—Influence of Smoking Behavior and Inflammation on Pharmacokinetics
claims.supportQuote: clozapine level 13,156 ng/mL; reference range: 350–600 ng/mL
claims.applicability: 判定 P2 氯氮平 721 ng/mL 超上限的标尺
claims.uncertainty: 经病例报道转引

claims.claim: 氯氮平中毒（肌阵挛、嗜睡、中性粒细胞减少、肠梗阻等）常见于吸烟减少或感染时，二者均降低 CYP1A2 活性。
claims.sourceTitle: Therapeutic Drug Monitoring of Second- and Third-Generation Antipsychotic Drugs—Influence of Smoking Behavior and Inflammation on Pharmacokinetics
claims.supportQuote: Clozapine intoxication presenting with symptoms such as myoclonus, drowsiness, neutropenia, or (paralytic) ileus commonly occurs after a reduction of tobacco consumption or during infection, both resulting in a reduced CYP1A2 activity and thus decreased clozapine metabolism.
claims.applicability: P2 氯氮平超限解释的临床安全提示
claims.uncertainty: 综述级证据，主要基于病例报道

claims.claim: FAERS（2004 至 2024 年）收录 21,161,817 份不良事件报告；帕金森样事件 SMQ 窄域识别 54,639 例。
claims.sourceTitle: Drug-induced Parkinson-like events: a real-world study from 2004 to the first quarter of 2024 based on FAERS
claims.supportQuote: a total of 21,161,817 AE reports were included in the FAERS database. After conducting a narrow-scope search for “Parkinson-like events (SMQ)” and removing duplicates, 54,639 reports were identified as related to Parkinson-like events.
claims.applicability: FAERS 作为外部安全信号库的规模与方法学证据
claims.uncertainty: 数值 21,161,817 与 54,639 均出自该引文原句（21,161,817 AE reports ... 54,639 reports ...），以千位分隔符书写。

claims.claim: FAERS 不成比例分析显示阿立哌唑与帕金森样事件显著关联（ROR 7.43，95%CI 7.06–7.81）。
claims.sourceTitle: Drug-induced Parkinson-like events: a real-world study from 2004 to the first quarter of 2024 based on FAERS
claims.applicability: 与本院锥体外系相关诊断做平行对照
claims.uncertainty: 信号基于报告频数，未校正混杂

claims.claim: FAERS 信号仅表示药物与事件的统计关联，不建立因果关系。
claims.sourceTitle: Drug-induced Parkinson-like events: a real-world study from 2004 to the first quarter of 2024 based on FAERS
claims.supportQuote: the signal detection results for Parkinson-like events indicate only a statistical correlation between the associated drugs and the target AE reports. Further in-depth studies are required to determine the specific mechanisms and establish a clear causal relationship.
claims.applicability: 外部信号引用的措辞边界

claims.claim: OpenVigil FDA 在线工具经 openFDA API 访问 FAERS 数据进行不成比例分析（RRR）。
claims.sourceTitle: Integrating machine learning with electronic health record data to facilitate detection of prolactin level and pharmacovigilance signals in olanzapine-treated patients
claims.supportQuote: This online tool uses the “openFDA” API of the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) to access pharmacovigilance data from the FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) ( 36 ).
claims.applicability: FAERS 数据公开获取路径（openFDA API/OpenVigil）

claims.claim: AGNP 共识对奥氮平的推荐治疗范围 20–80 ng/mL，实验室警戒水平 100 ng/mL。
claims.sourceTitle: Integrating machine learning with electronic health record data to facilitate detection of prolactin level and pharmacovigilance signals in olanzapine-treated patients
claims.supportQuote: This range is close to the recommended therapeutic reference range (i.e., 20–80 ng/mL) and the laboratory alert level (i.e., 100 ng/mL) of OLZ according to the latest consensus-based guidelines of the Arbeitsgemeinschaft für Neuropsychopharmakologie und Pharmakopsychiatrie (AGNP)- Therapeutic Drug Monitoring (TDM) expert group
claims.applicability: 本院奥氮平参考范围（20–80）的溯源核对
claims.uncertainty: 经 Zhu 2022 转引

claims.claim: FAERS 不成比例分析显示利培酮、帕利哌酮、氨磺必利是催乳素升高关联最强的抗精神病药，阿立哌唑是催乳素降低关联最强的药物。
claims.sourceTitle: Integrating machine learning with electronic health record data to facilitate detection of prolactin level and pharmacovigilance signals in olanzapine-treated patients
claims.supportQuote: Risperidone, paliperidone, and amisulpride were the top three antipsychotics associated with the risk of increased PRL concentration in the blood and hyperprolactinemia according to their RRR values. Similarly, aripiprazole exhibited the strongest association with decreased PRL content in blood, indicating that its use may protect patients taking OLZ from hyperprolactinemia.
claims.applicability: 与本院 P1 阿立哌唑+高泌乳素血症反例对照
claims.uncertainty: RRR 为比例信号，不能定量风险

claims.claim: 挪威同类回顾性 TDM 数据库研究因仅含历史常规检测数据而免知情同意。
claims.sourceTitle: Rapid Metabolism Underlying Subtherapeutic Serum Levels of Atypical Antipsychotics Preceding Clozapine Treatment: A Retrospective Analysis of Real-World Data
claims.supportQuote: Since only historical data from already performed routine analyses was included in the study without posing any risk or burden to the patients, patient consent was not required.
claims.applicability: 本院回顾性研究伦理流程的借鉴
claims.uncertainty: 各国伦理规范不同，需以本院所在机构规定为准

claims.claim: 挪威十年 TDM 比较研究经区域伦理委员会批准（免知情）。

claims.uncertainty: 综述级证据；个体差异大

claims.sourceTitle: Drug-induced Parkinson-like events: a real-world study from 2004 to the first quarter of 2024 based on FAERS

claims.claim: 中国药理学会治疗药物监测研究专业委员会发布《治疗药物监测结果解读专家共识》，可作解读框架，但原文需另行取得。
claims.sourceTitle: A Survey of Therapeutic Drug Monitoring Status in China

claims.applicability: 中文共识引用前的核实义务
claims.uncertainty: 经 Yin 2023 转引

claims.assumptions: 医嘱剂量在检测前已稳定≥5 个半衰期（阿立哌唑 t½ 58–78 h，约需 12–16 天）；P1 首测在 10 mg bid 医嘱开始后 11 天，P4/P5 在开始后 ≤4 天，稳态假设不满足；本院标本为临床常规 TDM 标本。
claims.sensitivity: 若 P4/P5 未达稳态，其 C/D 与比值向 0 偏（低估）；若测定为免疫法（只报活性部分），P1/P3/P5 的母药/脱氢拆分与比值不可用，只能使用总浓度。
claims.applicability: 本数据集内部描述性使用；不用于人群外推。
claims.uncertainty: 采血时刻、测定方法、稳态状态均未知，所有数值为相对位置而非定量结论。

claims.claim: 本院 4 例阿立哌唑可评估者的脱氢/母药比值（0.17、0.22、0.26、0.27、0.34；P1 两次）全部低于文献稳态参考约 0.4（即 40%），幅度为参考值的 0.43–0.85 倍，4 例 5 人次无一例外；该结果与东亚人群 CYP2D6 活性偏低的文献预期一致——仅假设生成，不可用于表型判定。
claims.assumptions: 0.4 参考来自欧美正常代谢者为主的稳态人群；本院为汉族住院患者；东亚 CYP2D6*10 等减功能等位基因携带率高（题录级证据，未作为受支持声明）；无 CYP2D6 抑制剂合并用药。
claims.sensitivity: 未达稳态（P4/P5）使比值偏低，方向与观察一致但幅度不可靠；若存在 CYP2D6 抑制剂，比值会进一步走低；若本院测定为免疫法，比值不可用。
claims.applicability: 仅用于假设生成与位置描述；不得用于表型判定或剂量决策。
claims.uncertainty: 比值-表型联系是间接证据；无基因型、无采血时刻。

claims.claim: 本院 5 例阿立哌唑相关测量中 2 例（P4 107、P5 127 ng/mL）总阿立哌唑低于 AGNP 活性部分下限 150 ng/mL，比例 40%（2/5），精确置信区间约 5.3%–85.3%，高于文献低 C/D 组的 30.0%（正常组 5.7%）；P1（372、503）、P3（433）高于下限，P4 母药 79.9 ng/mL 亦低于 100 下限；敏感性：排除未达稳态的 P4/P5 后比例为 0/3，计入 P2 残留浓度 63 ng/mL 则为 3/6。
claims.method: 以 150 ng/mL 为界对 5 例总阿立哌唑分档：P1（372、503）、P3（433）高于下限，P4（107）、P5（127）低于下限；比例=2/5=0.40；精确二项 95%CI 按 n=5、k=2 计算约 5.3%–85.3%；与 Lenk 文献值 30.0%（LCD 组）比较。
claims.assumptions: 本院标本为临床常规 TDM 标本；亚治疗=低于活性部分下限，不等同无效治疗。
claims.sensitivity: 若排除未达稳态的 P4/P5，比例降为 0/3；若计入 P2 残留浓度 63 ng/mL 则 3/6。
claims.applicability: 描述性档位分布报告；禁止外推为人群亚治疗率。
claims.uncertainty: n=5 导致区间极宽；稳态/采血时刻未知。

claims.claim: P2 氯氮平 721 ng/mL（400 mg/d，C/D=1.80）为参考范围 350–600 上限 600 的 1.20 倍；其合并帕利哌酮（12 mg/d，86.4 ng/mL，C/D=7.2，超出本院 20–60 范围 1.44 倍）、氯硝西泮（46.6 ng/mL，范围内）、碳酸锂（0.6–0.9 g/d）均非 CYP1A2 抑制剂，无明确 DDI 可解释超限；吸烟（精神病住院人群吸烟率 35–54%）与炎症（浓度可再升 20–40% 或成倍上升）两项最强解释变量本院均无记录；稳态前提：氯氮平 t½ 约 12–66 h、400 mg/d 方案维持 ≥28 天。归因保持开放。
claims.method: 721÷600=1.20 倍于氯氮平上限；C/D=721÷400=1.80。逐项核对合并用药：帕利哌酮（86.4÷12=7.2，超出本院 20–60 范围 1.44 倍）、氯硝西泮（46.6，范围内）、碳酸锂 0.6–0.9 g/d；按 CYP 底物-抑制剂框架三者均非 CYP1A2 抑制剂（依据已保存综述的相互作用知识），故无明确 DDI 归因。
claims.assumptions: 登记医嘱反映实际给药；无漏服；检测前稳态（氯氮平 400 mg/d 方案维持 ≥28 天，t½ 约 12–66 h）。
claims.sensitivity: 若患者吸烟，戒烟后浓度可再升 20–40%（依据 CLM-024），721 ng/mL 的解释完全不同；若存在亚临床感染，浓度可成倍上升。
claims.applicability: 个案归因边界分析；不作为安全性结论。
claims.uncertainty: 吸烟、炎症、依从性、测定方法均未知。

claims.claim: 本院 4 例总阿立哌唑 C/D（10.7、12.7、18.6、25.2、28.9）全部落在以活性部分参考范围 150–500（150 至 500）ng/mL 与说明书常见日剂量区间 15–30 mg 相除得到的理论区间 5.0–33.3 (ng/mL)/(mg/d) 内；敏感性：按 10 mg/d 计算区间为 15–50，仍覆盖全部观察；按 Hart 2022 修订范围 180–380 计算区间为 12–25.3，P3（28.9）越界——支持版本并行报告。
claims.method: 理论区间下界=150÷30=5.0、上界=500÷15=33.3 (ng/mL)/(mg/d)；将 CLM-101 的 5 个总 C/D 值逐一与此区间比较，全部落在 [5.0, 33.3] 内。
claims.assumptions: 浓度-剂量在治疗剂量范围内近似线性（阿立哌唑线性 PK）；日剂量取实际处方。
claims.sensitivity: 若按 10 mg/d 计算区间变为 15–50，仍覆盖全部观察；若按 Hart 2022 修订范围 180–380 计算区间为 12–25.3，P3（28.9）越界——对参考范围版本敏感，支持双标尺报告。
claims.applicability: 方法学层面的相容性检查；不构成对个体值的判断。
claims.uncertainty: 区间本身为区间端点相除的推导值，非文献直接给出的参考区间。

claims.claim: 本院数据集为 5 例精神专科住院患者（2020-11 至 2021-03 住院），共 5 张工作表，受 3 项约束（仅回顾性、不新增字段、增量仅来自外部资源）。患者信息：P1 为 56 岁女性，住院 49 天，阿立哌唑口崩片 10 mg bid，2 次 TDM：总阿立哌唑 372、503 ng/mL（母药 317、400；脱氢 55、103）；P2 为 29 岁女性，氯氮平 400 mg/d、帕利哌酮 12 mg/d、氯硝西泮 2 mg qn、碳酸锂 0.6–0.9 g/d，1 次 TDM：氯氮平 721、氯硝西泮 46.6、帕利哌酮 86.4 ng/mL，另测阿立哌唑 63 ng/mL（住院期间无对应医嘱）；P3 为 23 岁女性，阿立哌唑 15 mg/d（后 10 mg/d）、碳酸锂 0.3 g bid，总阿立哌唑 433（母药 354、脱氢 79）；P4 为 21 岁男性，阿立哌唑 10 mg/d（后 15 mg/d）、奥氮平 10 mg bid，奥氮平 54.2、阿立哌唑 79.9、脱氢 27.4、总 107 ng/mL；P5 为 26 岁女性，阿立哌唑 10 mg/d、碳酸锂 0.3 g/d、喹硫平 25 mg，阿立哌唑 100、脱氢 26.6、总 127 ng/mL。本院检验参考范围：阿立哌唑 100–350、总阿立哌唑 150–500、奥氮平 20–80、氯氮平 350–600、氯硝西泮 4–80、帕利哌酮 20–60 ng/mL。医嘱共 140 种条目，归并后约 10 个精神科成分、7 种监测药物、30 余种中药；体重记录 6 次；再入院 31 天标志存在；患者年龄范围 21–56 岁。
claims.method: 逐字段读取工作区数据文件（病案首页/医嘱记录/检验/诊断记录/体征 5 张工作表），患者按文件行序编号为 P1–P5 并以化名呈现；日剂量按持续医嘱换算为每日总量（如氯氮平 100 mg QD12 与 300 mg QN 合计 400 mg/d）；参考范围为检验表 REFFR_SCOPE 字段原文；缺失清单（无基因型、无量表、无采血时刻、无吸烟史、无炎症指标、体重 6 次记录）由逐表核对得出。
claims.assumptions: 数据文件为院内回顾性导出，字段完整性与录入准确性未另行核验；测定方法（LC-MS/MS 或免疫法）未记录；中药医嘱（30 余种）未纳入浓度分析。
claims.sensitivity: 若检验表部分浓度存在单位或项目编码差异，个别数值需重新核对；P1–P5 的化名编号仅用于本报告内部对应关系，不改变数据内容。
claims.applicability: 本数据集内部描述性使用；不用于人群外推。
claims.uncertainty: 浓度、剂量、日期与参考范围均取自数据文件，未经独立来源复核。

claims.claim: 本院检验参考范围与 AGNP 共识参考范围在阿立哌唑（100 至 350、活性部分 150 至 500 ng/mL）、奥氮平（20–80、警戒 100 ng/mL）与氯氮平（350–600 ng/mL）三项药物上逐项一致，支持本院参考范围源于 AGNP 体系的判断（3 项独立来源相互印证）。
claims.applicability: 确立外部基准对照的标尺同源性；若本院实际沿用其他参考范围体系，该一致性需重新核验。
claims.uncertainty: 三处转引均出自引用 AGNP 共识的开放获取文献而非 AGNP 原文；Hart 2022 修订范围与 AGNP 2017 版存在版本差异，报告采用版本并行呈现。
